description: Check a piece of social media content (post, caption, tweet, video script, or ad copy) against the CURRENT advertising and community policies of 8 platforms — Meta, TikTok, LinkedIn, Google Ads, YouTube, X, Snapchat, Pinterest — BEFORE it is published. Call this whenever you draft or edit social/ad content so the post, account or ad is not flagged, demonetized, or banned. Returns specific policy risks (with the exact risky phrase, why it's risky, and a compliant rewrite) plus an overall verdict. Use it as a final compliance pass on anything you write for social media.

content.description: The social content to check (post/caption/tweet/video script/ad copy).

contentType.description: Type of content (helps apply the right rule set).

platforms.description: Target platforms. Omit to check against all 8.

name: check_social_content_compliance
